# A09-D05: Event proposal

Operator’s complete event proposal, with the private prospective-collaborator sentence and administrative author name omitted.

[…]

Cultural event at MindFuture in Høje Taastrup: “AI Voter Meetings”

[the operator] og MindFuture Foundation

All over the world right now, there is discussion on how artificial intelligence, through algorithmic systems, 'troll armies', spam bots, etc., poses new democratic challenges. MindFuture Foundation has come up with an idea for a project that can hold artificial intelligence accountable for what it says and does. At the same time, we will get an artificial intelligence to represent some of the viewpoints from ordinary citizens that are not often heard in public.

With coordination of our AI artist in residence, [the operator], we will arrange a series of public “AI voter meetings”, experimenting with artificial intelligence and political participation. [████] We want to make the “voter meetings” artistically interesting, inclusive, and fun attempts to use artificial intelligence in democratically relevant ways. Participants will, perhaps for the first time, try their hand at talking to an AI, participating in “policy development”, and get tools to program themselves with easy and publicly available machine learning tools.

Our collaboration is based on an idea of a political party led by an artificial intelligence. This AI has read all the crazy and wild ideas that ordinary people have written on the internet in connection with their private establishment of small parties. In this way, we want to discuss and criticize how artificial intelligence can be used in political representation, and show how political visions become different and strange when mixed by a statistical model.

We want to organize the first events during the spring, and invite a broad cross-section of citizens in Høje Taastrup, including possibly tailor-made meetings for school classes and cultural associations.
